name: js-parse-query
instruction: Implement parseQuery.js (CommonJS): module.exports = parseQuery. parseQuery(qs) parses a query string into an object. A leading '?' is optional. A key repeated more than once becomes an ARRAY of its values in order; a key seen once stays a string. A key with no '=' maps to the empty string ''. Percent-encoding must be decoded in BOTH keys and values, and '+' means a space. Empty input returns {}.
